rationale: All three selected PDFs processed successfully with the hybrid docling-fast backend and produced JSON/Markdown/HTML/Text outputs without Java-only fallback. The outputs show useful sidecar potential for layout-aware parsing and evidence anchoring, but OCR-on-scanned-PDF and table fidelity remain unproven and no graph-readiness/import claim is made.
remaining_evidence_gaps: No scanned/image-only PDF was included, so OCR quality remains not proven.
No independent table ground truth was used, so table fidelity is qualitative only.
Outputs are candidate evidence only and are not graph-ready or import-eligible.
Need a larger probe before production adoption or sidecar schema commitment.

contract_mapping.mapping: Supported as candidate sidecar input: each output can be tied to manifest article_key, source_path, sha256, local PDF provenance, and generated output paths.
contract_mapping.remaining_gap: Need stable schema for storing OpenDataLoader output references without copying large payloads into KG artifacts.

contract_mapping.mapping: Partially supported: JSON includes page/layout metadata and bounding boxes, so evidence anchors can be derived from output elements plus source PDF hash.
contract_mapping.remaining_gap: Need deterministic element-id/path convention and review before using as evidence paths.

contract_mapping.mapping: Promising sidecar candidate: JSON/Markdown expose headings, page metadata, reading-order text, and layout blocks useful for page/section indexing.
contract_mapping.remaining_gap: Need compare against current PageIndex expectations and decide how tables/figures become nodes.

contract_mapping.mapping: Candidate input only: Markdown/text can seed chunks, but chunk boundaries must still pass daily-archive chunk/evidence validation and refusal handling.
contract_mapping.remaining_gap: No direct promotion to SemanticChunk without chunk replay and source-span validation.

contract_mapping.mapping: Partial candidate: table-like signals are present, but no ground-truth table fidelity benchmark was run.
contract_mapping.remaining_gap: Need table-specific benchmark/review before accepting table structures.

contract_mapping.mapping: Runtime diagnostics are usable: command, exit code, backend health, fallback usage, cache dependency, stderr/stdout excerpts, and per-paper status are captured.
contract_mapping.remaining_gap: Need normalize OpenDataLoader runtime errors into daily-archive diagnostic codes if integrated.

contract_mapping.mapping: Not satisfied by parser output alone. Outputs can become reviewer packet candidates only after mapping/review.
contract_mapping.remaining_gap: Independent graph-readiness review remains required; no import eligibility claim.
